source.title: HuD interacts with Bdnf mRNA and is essential for activity-induced BDNF synthesis in dendrites.

confidence_rationale: Supplies the MECHANISM SHAPE the staged candidate plasticity.signal_as_proposal_not_update asks for, in the adult brain and at the right grain. The default state of the long-3'UTR Bdnf mRNA in dendrites is BASAL REPRESSION; activity-dependent signalling, via PKC phosphorylation of HuD at specific threonine residues (149/165), RELIEVES that repression and permits local translation. So the plasticity signal does not itself write -- it removes a standing block on a write that is already staged and waiting. That is the proposal/commit separation, implemented in molecular biology. Held at 0.69: PLoS ONE, in-vitro/ex-vivo dendritic translation assays, and the claim REE draws is architectural rather than the paper's own.
failure_signatures: The gate here is a DERE-PRESSION (removing a standing block), not an ADMISSION (opening a window). The staged candidate plasticity.typed_gated_event_controller is written in admission terms. These are behaviourally different when the gating signal fails: a failed de-repression leaves the write blocked (safe-by-default), a failed admission gate can leave it permanently open. The candidate should state which it is before registration.

The specificity is at the level of an individual mRNA's 3'UTR, i.e. per-TARGET, not per-EVENT. The staged depth-ladder and typed-event candidates assume a controller that types the EVENT and then permits a class of writes. Vanevski & Xu's biology types the TARGET and lets any sufficient activity through. Mapping one onto the other is a genuine architectural choice, not a transcription.
PKC-mediated phosphorylation of HuD is one of several convergent routes to dendritic BDNF; the paper does not show it is necessary in vivo for learning, so the gate's exclusivity is unestablished.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Neuronal ELAV-family RNA-binding proteins associate in vivo with Bdnf mRNA isoforms in the adult brain in an activity-dependent manner. HuD interacts directly with the long Bdnf 3' untranslated region and co-localises with Bdnf mRNA in hippocampal dendrites. Activation of protein kinase C increases dendritic translation of mRNAs carrying the long Bdnf 3'UTR, and this depends on HuD and on its phosphorylation at threonine 149 and/or 165. Activity-dependent signalling can therefore relieve basal repression of Bdnf mRNA translation in dendrites.
mapping.ree_translation: The staged candidate plasticity.signal_as_proposal_not_update holds that a plasticity signal should PROPOSE a write rather than perform one, with a separate gate deciding whether the proposal commits. Vanevski & Xu show the adult brain implementing exactly this separation at the molecular level: the transcript is already positioned in the dendrite, already bound, and already repressed -- the write is staged. The activity-dependent signal's job is not to deliver content but to release the standing repression so the staged write executes locally. REE's translation is that the residue/signal path and the commit path are separable in biology, which is what the candidate asserts architecturally.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The direction of the gate is the caveat and it matters. This is DE-REPRESSION: the default is blocked and the signal unblocks. Several of the staged candidates (typed_gated_event_controller, depth_ladder_eight_rungs) are written in ADMISSION terms, where a controller opens a window. Those fail differently -- de-repression fails safe, admission can fail open. Additionally the biology's specificity is per-TARGET (this mRNA's 3'UTR) while the candidates assume per-EVENT typing. Neither gap is fatal, but registering the candidates without resolving them would import an ambiguity the biology does not have.
mapping.source_context: Rat and mouse hippocampal neurons; in vivo RNA-protein association plus dendritic translation assays with PKC activation and phospho-mutant HuD.

confidence_components.notes: PLoS ONE with converging in vivo association and mechanistic phospho-mutant work; source quality moderate rather than high. Mapping fidelity is the entry's strength -- the staged/repressed/released structure is unusually close to the candidate's own wording. Transfer risk moderate: molecular gating to an architectural commit gate.
